sentences.text: 该概念源于瑞典经济学家维克塞尔，他于1898年发表研究对自然利率作出定义。
sentences.evidence: the concept itself was originated by the Swedish economist Knut Wicksell. Wicksell published a study in 1898 defining the natural rate of interest

sentences.text: 凯恩斯在1930年的《货币论》中引入了“自然利率”一词。
sentences.evidence: Following Wicksell, J. M. Keynes introduced the term "natural rate of interest" in his A Treatise on Money (1930).

sentences.text: 1990年代央行政策目标开始转变后，该概念重获关注，“中性利率”一词逐渐取代“自然利率”。
sentences.evidence: When during the 1990s the central bank policy targets started changing, the concept began attracting renewed attention, and the term "neutral rate" gradually replaced "natural rate".
